name: Nami Trigger Refill
summary: Low-cost blue setup pieces keep cards moving so Nami lines never run dry.
resultText: Repeated hand refills and tempo-positive setup turns
steps: Lead on Nami or another cheap blue value piece.
Use bounce or filter effects to keep the hand stocked.
Convert the extra cards into repeated pressure turns.
prerequisites: Blue shell with room for cheap cantrip-style effects.

name: Jet Pistol Pressure Curve
summary: Cheap red pressure backed by efficient removal keeps the board clear enough for leader swings to matter.
resultText: Aggressive tempo line with removal support
steps: Commit an early Straw Hat attacker.
Use Gum-Gum Jet Pistol to remove the key blocker.
Push the open attack step before the opponent can reset.
prerequisites: An aggressive red shell with follow-up attackers.
